rationale: The discourse has clarified the economics and produced a side-by-side framing, but the core conflict remains unresolved: labour and the state still reject closures and compulsory redundancies, while management, owners, and investors still insist on near-closure-equivalent savings. Positions have hardened over the last two rounds into a stable impasse, so further direct round-robin bargaining is unlikely to change much without a mediator forcing trade-off exploration.
